title: TB6612FNG motor driver
prompt: a TB6612FNG dual motor driver breakout with two motors: power the bench, then send forward, reverse, brake and coast commands at different PWM speeds; see-through labels the MOSFET H-bridges, PWM and direction pins and motor outputs
blurb: Snap on the 9V battery and drive two gear motors through the TB6612FNG's H-bridges: forward, reverse, short brake or coast, at four PWM speeds, while see-through lights up the MOSFETs that conduct.
